items.question: How is a bespoke thobe different from a made-to-measure one?
items.answer: Made-to-measure adjusts an existing pattern template to your measurements. Bespoke means a pattern is formulated from your measurements alone, with no template underneath — that is how Bespoke Tailor builds every garment.

items.question: How long does production take?
items.answer: Production time depends on fabric and current workshop capacity, and is shown as a live estimate during the design process based on your specific order.

items.question: Can I start the design process without visiting the studio?
items.answer: Yes — Design My Thobe lets you explore fabric and fit options online first; a private appointment and measurement session follows before production begins.

items.question: Where is my thobe made?
items.answer: Every garment is cut, sewn, and finished by hand in our workshop in Bandung, Indonesia.
